The 2018 ACM-ICPC Asia Xuzhou Regional Programming Contest

A. Rikka with Minimum Spanning Trees
int minimum_spanning_tree(int N, int M, edge[] E);
- Find the minimum spanning tree of the graph G.

B. Rikka with Line Graphs
int count_vertices(int N, int M, edge[] E);
- Count the number of vertices in L^6(G), where L(G) is the line graph of G.

C. Rikka with Consistency
double minimum_time(int N, int[] H);
- Given a polyline connecting (i - 1, H[i - 1]) and (i, H[i]) for all i.
- Piece A at (0, 0) and piece B at (N, 0). Move simulatenously at same height with larger time.
- Find minimum time to swap pieces A and B.

D. Rikka with Subsequences
int cube_sum(int N, int[] A, bool[][] R);
- Valid subsequence B of A are those with R[B[i]][B[i + 1]] all true.
- Count the sum of cube of occurrences for each distinct subsequence.

E. Rikka with Data Structure
void init(int N, int[] A);
- Given a integer array A of length N.
void range_add(int L, int R, int K);
- For all i in [L, R], A[i] := A[i] + K.
void range_update(int L, int R, int K);
- For all i in [L, R], A[i] := K.
int count(int L, int R, int X);
- Count number of indices Y such that max(A[min(X, Y)..max(X, Y)]) = max(A[X], A[Y]).

F. Rikka with Nice Counting Striking Back
int count_nice_substrings(string S);
- A substring T is nice iff TP is not substring of S for all P where TP = PT.
- Count the number of nice substrings.

G. Rikka with Intersection of Paths
int count_paths(int N, edge[] E, int M, int K, path[] P);
- Given a tree T of N nodes and M paths on the tree P.
- Count the number of ways to select K paths such that each pair has intersection.

H. Rikka with A Long Colour Palette
int[] colourful_segments(int N, int K, range[] A);
- Given N ranges. Colour the segments such that positions with all K colours is maximised.

I. Rikka with Sorting Networks
int count_almost_sorted(int N, int K, (int, int)[] C);
- Given an arbitrary permutation of length N and K comparators C.
- A permutation is almost sorted iff its longest increasing subsequence is of length at least N - 1.
- Count the number of permutations that is almost sorted after the sorting network.

J. Rikka with An Unnamed Temple
(int, int) find_paths(int N, int[] W, int[] C, int M, edge[] E, int K, int T);
- Given a direct acyclic graph G.
- Each node i has treasure of weight W[i] and value C[i].
- Find maximum total value and the respective number of paths, with total weight modulo K is T.

K. Rikka with Ants
double minimise_time(int N, int[] A, int S1, int E1, int S2, int E2);
- Given a cyclic graph of N nodes where the distance between node i and node i + 1 is A[i].
- For mixed strategy, minimise the expected time for one to move from S1 to E1 and another to move from S2 to E2.

L. Rikka with Grid Graphs
int count_orientations(int N, int M, char[][] A);
- Given a grid graph of N rows and M columns.
- Count the number of orientations of edges such that the result graph does not contain cycle.

M. Rikka with Illuminations
int shiny_days(int N, point[] P, int M, point[] I);
- Given a convex polygon P and M points I.
- Pick minimum number of points in I such that all the exterior of P are light.
